instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections. Use customized Shadcn for the dashboard and chat inputs.
Implement a Neo-Brutalist UI: everything interactive should have a hard black border (`border-2 border-[#09090B]`) and a solid black shadow (`shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]`).
When a button is hovered or clicked, shift it down and right, and reduce the shadow size so it feels tactile and physically pressed.
For the main app UI: Use a split-screen layout on desktop. Left side: Chatbot interface where the AI asks questions. Right side: Live generated resume preview.
On mobile: The chat interface takes up the full screen. Add a sticky floating action button (FAB) or bottom sheet to toggle the 'Live Resume Preview'.
Font choices: Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. The actual generated resume document must use standard ATS-friendly fonts like 'Inter'.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing (e.g., data-testid='login-google-button').
Never use a fully transparent header over images; ensure the nav is visible with a solid or thick glassmorphism background.
Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` for all icons, preferably using 'bold' weight to match the brutalist lines.
Do not use generic placeholder images like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the URLs provided in the media section of this JSON.
